# F1: Notification Preferences
<!-- packet-artifact-id:v1 {"uid":"cd2f771d-eb28-47c0-9771-172397c22565","displayId":"F1","title":"Notification Preferences"} -->
<!-- packet-change:v1 {"schemaVersion":1,"uid":"cd2f771d-eb28-47c0-9771-172397c22565","displayId":"F1","status":"draft"} -->

**Status:** Draft

## Intent
Give users control over how notifications reach them, where preferences persist, and how the UI appears, so people tune alerts to their workflow instead of accepting one-size-fits-all behavior.

## Current Behavior
Baseline planning stage: no notification system, preference persistence, or appearance settings exist yet in this product.

## Desired Behavior
- Users configure notification preferences; choices apply going forward and survive restarts according to the chosen storage model.
- Users pick which notification channels/levels fire (behavior).
- Users pick an interface theme (appearance).
Each of storage, behavior, and theme is an independent setting decidable on its own.

## Scope
- In: a preferences surface exposing the three independent settings; persistence per the chosen storage model; reasonable defaults; sensible fallbacks for unsupported channels.
- Out: multi-account sync, per-rule scheduling, admin/user management.

## Affected Product Areas
Preferences UI, settings persistence layer, notification dispatch (new), theme/appearance rendering.

## Requirements
1. Preferences screen exposes three independent settings: storage choice, notification behavior, theme choice.
2. Preferences persist via the decided storage model and restore on next session.
3. Notification delivery honors the chosen behavior settings.
4. Theme choice restyles the UI.
5. Defaults exist for all three when unset.

## Decisions and Assumptions
Pending user decisions (see open items):
- **Storage**: where preferences persist (local store vs cloud-backed) — undetermined.
- **Notification behavior**: which channels/types deliver (desktop, push, email, etc.) — undetermined.
- **Theme**: appearance model (light/dark/system-follow) — undetermined.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Setting each of the three independently works without touching the others.
- Restart restores the stored preferences.
- Changing notification behavior changes delivery accordingly.
- Changing theme visually restyles the UI without affecting other settings.

ramifications: Affects privacy posture and install-time experience

decision_brief.whyNow: Drives storage design and migration strategy for F1; independent of behavior and theme choices.
